description: blocks-affixes: affixes and affixPools sections: schema (an affix name's own rule, a stat that is none, a range at 0, no tiers, a misspelt field, max over 8), KL314 for a pool entry that is no affix of the mod or another kind of block and for a pool item that is nothing or not an item (a game item and another mod's affix are fine), KL305 for a pool named like an affix; affix sections ask no more than clients none (no KL201).
